        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x_left, y_center, beam_w, h, density=density)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(beam, restitution=0.05)
        left_beams.append(beam)
        y_prev_top = y_center + h / 2  # Top of this beam

    # Middle beam (1 beam only)
    middle_y = 4.0
    middle_h = 0.6

    # Connect consecutive left beams at midpoints (vertical stacking)
    for i in range(1, len(left_beams)):

        sandbox.add_joint(body_a, body_b, (x_left, y_anchor), type='rigid')
